ambient_events: The press bar takes a pull with a heavy, satisfying clunk, and a sheet comes off wet.
Drying sheets hang from a line on wooden pegs, still tacky, faces turned to the wall.
A tin bucket of ash sits by the door with a scrap of unburned edge on top.
description: A hand-set flatbed press, four cases of lead type, and the good sharp stink of ink. Orders travel the Long Watch on paper, carried in a pocket, read once and burned, because a thing that was never a signal was never intercepted. The compositor's stick sits half-full on the stone, someone's evening interrupted, the line reading backwards and upside down as all true things do here.
name: The Press
